## About
Muhammad (known professionally as Dev Muhammad, and online as Unfathomable-08 / unfathomable_08) is a Full-Stack Web and Applied AI Developer based in Karachi, Pakistan. With over 2 years of professional experience and 35+ production projects shipped, he specializes in building high-performance Next.js and React applications, scalable Node.js/Python backends, and custom AI agents/automations (LangChain, PyTorch, FAISS).
